answer.reason: The verses tell what was made of the calves, where they were set and how they were used in worship, so a short line can be written.

clauses.english: were made of gold by Jeroboam and set up at Bethel and Dan
were sacrificed to by Jeroboam at Bethel, with priests placed there for them
clauses.quote: sacrificing unto the calves that he had made

doubts: 2KI 17:16 says only 'two calves' among the sins of Israel, so it was not used as a separate clause.
Jehu's keeping of the calves (2KI 10:29) was left out as a detail of Jehu's own story rather than of the calves.
